purpose: Validate the central registry of property fixture governance validation runs for identity, immutability, traceability and separation from legal verification and publication.

checks.name: Run identity
checks.requirement: Every entry has a unique run ID.

checks.name: Contract traceability
checks.requirement: Every run points to its validation contract.

checks.name: Execution record
checks.requirement: Execution mode, date and result are recorded.

checks.name: Immutability
checks.requirement: Completed run records cannot be silently overwritten.

checks.name: Legal separation
checks.requirement: Technical validation does not become legal verification.

checks.name: Publication separation
checks.requirement: Validation runs do not independently authorize publication.
